purpose: Frozen, independently resolvable release identities for the distribution/release surface. TT-S4EXT-001 / F001 exists because a single hand-copied `tag commit` string let the distributed pack name a DIFFERENT release's object than the one it claimed to describe. The two facts are therefore separate fields and must never be collapsed again.

field_semantics.tag_object: the annotated tag object sha (git rev-parse <tag>)
field_semantics.release_tag_target: the commit the annotated tag dereferences to (git rev-parse <tag>^{commit})
field_semantics.build_source_commit: the commit the distributed artifact BYTES were built from
field_semantics.published_asset_sha256: sha256 of the asset bytes as served by the GitHub release

authority_note: This file records identity facts and the current disposition. It grants nothing: it is not a publication approval, a release admission, a tag move or an asset replacement. The v0.1.1-preview.3 published asset is immutable and was NOT rewritten; a corrected rebuild is produced as a separate candidate file pending Release Owner authorisation.
